title: Move server Directory struct into mimi-protocol
description: mimid-server (bead mimid-1wgh.31) defines a local serde Directory struct for GET /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory because mimi-protocol's directory types (mimid-1wgh.5.2) did not exist yet. When .5.2 lands, replace the local struct with mimi-protocol's type and keep the server's hand-written §5.1 JSON test as the oracle.
notes:
2026-11-02: queued after mimid-1wgh.6.73 (in progress): Directory::new is called in 14 mimid-server test files plus http.rs/main.rs, overlapping the hub tests .6.73 edits. Approach: server builds a mimi_protocol::Directory (Some for each routed endpoint) via a server-side fn (an inherent constructor on the foreign type is impossible), router takes mimi_protocol::Directory, call sites updated; directory.rs unit test (hand-written §5.1 JSON) stays the oracle.
2026-11-02 implemented (uncommitted, main checkout): mimid-server's local Directory struct removed; mimid_server::directory now re-exports mimi_protocol::Directory and provides pub fn directory(base: &BaseUrl) -> Directory (Some for the nine routed endpoints, proxy_download None, same URLs/placeholders; UriTemplate::new expect justified by BaseUrl invariants). router/get handler serve it; http.rs, main.rs and 13 test files switched from Directory::new to directory() (mechanical, plus rustfmt reflows). No test expectation changed: directory.rs SPEC_EXAMPLE oracle and directory_routes.rs unchanged and passing. Six gates pass (95 suites).
close_reason: mimid-server serves mimi_protocol::Directory: pub use + pub fn directory(&BaseUrl) setting the nine routed endpoints (proxy_download None); router/handler take it; 16 call sites updated mechanically (verified: only import/call swaps and rustfmt reflow). directory.rs SPEC_EXAMPLE oracle unchanged and passing; directory_routes unchanged. Six gates pass (95 suites).
